skill.summary: Detect and filter prompt injection attacks in untrusted input. Use when processing external content (emails, web scrapes, API inputs, Discord messages, sub-agent outputs) or when building systems that accept user-provided text that will be passed to an LLM. Covers direct injection, jailbreaks, data exfiltration, privilege escalation, and context manipulation.

latestVersion.changelog: Initial release — injection detection, 5 threat categories, CLI filter
